svg.title: Rule tablet: The Procession's vows
svg.desc: The Procession's vows on a tall grey tablet carried on the wagon, soot from the lanterns up one edge: seven rules, with hand and City underlined.
svg.text: Only the Scribe's hand writes the road.
Only the Scribe's hand writes the road.
The road is never written backward.
The road is never written backward.
No pilgrim unmasks until the City.
No pilgrim unmasks until the City.
The pen is passed only from a dying
The pen is passed only from a dying
hand.
hand.
Whatever the road reaches, the pilgrims
Whatever the road reaches, the pilgrims
must enter.
must enter.
The City of Answer is where the road
The City of Answer is where the road
ends.
ends.
Ink is not wasted on what is not road.
Ink is not wasted on what is not road.
